parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Eta point W = 1.7, Q2 = 1.0, cos = 0, phi = 90, but set vcut to -0.1.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I’ll preflight the requested eta kinematics and cutoff first; input generation will only proceed if the cutoff is valid or has an unambiguous safe correction.
The eta kinematic point is valid. The requested negative `vcut` is accepted but switches EXCLURAD to its alternate `v` interpretation, so I will preserve it and record that risk.

The requested eta kinematics pass physical and lookup-table checks. I am generating the input with the requested negative `vcut`; it is retained as a known EXCLURAD mode-selection risk rather than silently changed.
